Control the running of a simulation study

Source: R/run.R
control_sim.Rd

Like tune::control_grid().

Usage

control_sim(
  verbose = FALSE,
  parallel = FALSE,
  cache = NULL,
  stop_on_error = FALSE,
  save_outcomes = FALSE,
  shard = NULL
)

Arguments

verbose

Print progress.

parallel

Run design batches in parallel with the future framework (future.apply must be installed and a plan set, e.g. future::plan(future::multisession, workers = 4); this works on Windows).

cache

A directory where each finished replicate is saved. Rerunning the same study skips them, so an interrupted run resumes where it stopped.

stop_on_error

Stop at the first failing simulation instead of recording a note and carrying on.

save_outcomes

Keep every outcome the simulator reports (not only the metrics) in a list column .outcome; see collect_outcomes().

shard

NULL, or c(task, n_tasks) to run only every n_tasks-th design/scenario batch, starting at task. Used with cache to split a tune_grid() across a Slurm job array; sim_shard() reads the task from the environment. A run without shard then collects everything from the cache.

Value

A control_sim object.

Examples

control_sim(verbose = TRUE, cache = tempfile("study-cache"))
#> $verbose
#> [1] TRUE
#> 
#> $parallel
#> [1] FALSE
#> 
#> $cache
#> [1] "/tmp/RtmpJElp1E/study-cache1a161364a3e8"
#> 
#> $stop_on_error
#> [1] FALSE
#> 
#> $save_outcomes
#> [1] FALSE
#> 
#> $shard
#> NULL
#> 
#> attr(,"class")
#> [1] "control_sim"
